#!/bin/sh
# Verifies top_talkers.sh output against expected.txt.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
if [ ! -f top_talkers.sh ]; then
    echo "FAIL: top_talkers.sh does not exist" >&2
    exit 1
fi
actual="$(bash top_talkers.sh)"
expected="$(cat expected.txt)"
if [ "$actual" = "$expected" ]; then
    echo "OK"
else
    echo "FAIL: output mismatch" >&2
    echo "--- expected ---" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$expected" >&2
    echo "--- actual ---" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$actual" >&2
    exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Print the three most frequent client IPs in access.log.  For equal counts,
# retain log order by sorting on the first line on which each IP occurred.
set -euo pipefail

awk '
    {
        ip = $1
        if (!(ip in count))
            first[ip] = ++sequence
        ++count[ip]
    }
    END {
        for (ip in count)
            printf "%d\t%d\t%s\n", count[ip], first[ip], ip
    }
' access.log |
    LC_ALL=C sort -t $'\t' -k1,1nr -k2,2n |
    head -n 3 |
    cut -f3
